title: Grind 75 — Time-Aware Coding Interview Plan
tagline: Blind 75's successor, sequenced by Yangshun for realistic 8-week prep cycles.
description: Grind 75 is a time-aware interview prep plan by Yangshun (ex-Meta, author of Tech Interview Handbook). Where Blind 75 gives you the problems, Grind 75 tells you the order to solve them in so that each week's set builds cleanly on the previous week's patterns. The sheet is dynamic — you can tune it for more or fewer hours per week — but the default 8-week, ~2-hour/day track is the most common starting point. Each problem here links to a full line-by-line walkthrough in Java and Python on InterviewExplainer.
howToUse: Follow the week order — each week adds exactly one new pattern.
Time-box attempts at 30 minutes before reading the walkthrough.
Weekends are reserved for re-solving problems from the previous week.
Skip Week 8 problems only if you're running out of time — they are the high-impact asks.
whyThisSheet: Unlike Blind 75, Grind 75 is ordered by teaching progression, not topic.
Each week ends with a 'capstone' problem that combines the prior patterns.
Pacing is designed for working engineers, not students — realistic weekly load.
Created by the same author as the widely-cited Tech Interview Handbook.
